course_name_original: Teoría de Estructuras y Construcciones Industriales
course_name_en: Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions
prerequisites: It is recommended to have completed the subjects corresponding to the BASIC TRAINING modules and those corresponding to the second year of the INDUSTRIAL BRANCH COMMON module.

learning_outcomes.text: Choose the ideal location for the industrial plant.
Carry out implementation and organization studies of the industrial plant.
Evaluate the environmental impact of industrial constructions.
Choose the most commonly used structural typologies and the most appropriate modeling for their analysis.

syllabus_topics: Calculation of isostatic structures with rigid and articulated nodes (Trusses)
Calculation of hyperstatic structures with rigid and articulated nodes (Force method and Slope-deflection method)
The industrial building: design and structural behavior
Calculation bases and actions on the industrial building

assessment_methods.method: Submitted assignments and laboratory practices (Industrial Constructions)

assessment_rules: The final grade for the course will be the average of the grades from its two parts (Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions), requiring a minimum of 5 points out of 10 in each. For Theory of Structures, a minimum of 2 points out of 10 is required in each of the important topics (PTV, calculation of isostatic structures, and calculation of hyperstatic structures). For Industrial Constructions, a minimum of 4 out of 10 is required in the final written exam and a minimum of 5 out of 10 in laboratory practices. Re-sit examinations follow the same criteria as ordinary or differentiated evaluation.
